gap: No result ChatGPT got states that VIOFO's 4K rear cameras (RNE800 for the rear window, RWE800 waterproof, $139.99 each on 2026-11-21) work only with the A229 Ultra front unit and not with the A229 Pro or A229 Plus, so an A229 Pro (4K + 2K) cannot be upgraded to dual 4K by buying a rear camera. The shopper has to buy the A229 Ultra kit itself.
standout_why: I read productbible.com/blog/best-4k-dash-cams (cited in chat 2). It names the A229 Ultra as IMX678 4K at both ends and covers HK4 and HK6 kits, but it gives no rear-camera compatibility. It also says 'Max storage: Not published' for the A229 Ultra, although VIOFO's own page says 512GB. ChatGPT's two answers lack the rear-module limit as well, and neither mentions Vantrue's S1 Pro Max 4K + 4K. I did not open the Car and Driver, VortexRadar, VIOFO FAQ or productbible front-and-rear pages because the per-call budget and VIOFO/Vantrue rate limits (HTTP 429) got in the way. So I can't fully rule out that one of them states the RNE800/RWE800 limit. That is why I scored 2, not 3.
decides: This confirms that a shopper who wants 4K front plus 4K rear from VIOFO must buy an A229 Ultra kit ($409.99 for the 2CH at viofo.com on 2026-11-21) and cannot upgrade an A229 Pro. The Vantrue S1 Pro Max 4K + 4K is also a 2-channel camera (front plus rear) with dual Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 sensors. DashCamTalk lists 4K 30 fps on both channels, its microSD ceiling is higher (1 TB against VIOFO's 512GB), and Vantrue's own store sells it for $239.99 (2026-11-21, Black Friday, no code). So the Vantrue honestly places in the top three, and it is the near-tie we can link when price matters. ChatGPT left it out entirely.

findings.label: 4K rear camera module compatibility
findings.value: The RNE800 4K HDR rear camera (Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678, 6 m cable) works only with the A229 Ultra front unit, not the A229 Pro or A229 Plus. $139.99
findings.source_title: VIOFO RNE800 4K HDR Rear Camera with 6M Cable and Sticker for A229 Ultra Series
findings.note: Maker text: 'the RNE800 is ONLY compatible with the A229 Ultra front unit. It is not compatible with the A229 Pro or A229 Plus.' Price from VIOFO's US Shopify store through storecheck search.

findings.label: 4K waterproof rear camera compatibility
findings.value: The RWE800 4K IP67 rear camera with F1.5 aperture works only with the A229 Ultra front unit, not the A229 Pro or A229 Plus. $139.99
findings.source_title: VIOFO RWE800 4K HDR Waterproof Rear Camera for A229 Ultra Series
findings.note: Maker text: 'the RWE800 is ONLY compatible with the A229 Ultra front unit. It is not compatible with the A229 Pro or A229 Plus.' It is the same camera that ships in the A229 Ultra-W kits.

findings.label: Channels, sensors, card ceiling, price
findings.value: 2-channel (front plus rear window), both 3840 × 2160 on Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 with HDR on both channels. microSD up to 512GB. $409.99
findings.source_title: VIOFO A229 Ultra 2CH 4K Front+4K Rear Dashcam with Dual Sony STARVIS 2 Sensors, 2-Channel 4K HDR
findings.note: Maker text: 'both the front and rear cameras record true 4K (3840×2160) simultaneously' and 'Supports microSD cards up to 512GB'. The store shows no compare-at price, so no sale is marked. ChatGPT's chat 1 card showed $299.99 at Best Buy, which I did not open. The full product page returned HTTP 429, so this text comes from the store's search feed.

findings.label: Adding a cabin camera (3-channel)
findings.value: The RNF210 1080p 210° infrared fisheye cabin camera ($89.99) fits the A229 Plus, A229 Pro and A229 Ultra. The 2CH product page says no firmware change is needed.
findings.source_title: VIOFO RNF210 1080P Infrared Fisheye Cabin Camera with 1M Jack Plug Cable and Sticker for A229 Plus/A229 Pro/A229 Ultra
findings.note: 'No firmware changes required' is from the A229 Ultra 2CH store text. The A229 Ultra 3CH kit with this cabin camera is $459.99 at https://www.viofo.com/products/viofo-a229-ultra-3ch-4k-front-4k-rear-1080p-fisheye-cabin-dashcam-with-triple-sony-starvis-2-sensors (read 2026-11-21).

findings.label: Rear cable limits
findings.value: Ships with a 6 m Type-C to Type-C rear cable. Spare cables come in 1, 6, 8 and 10 m for $9.99. They cannot be extended with other USB cables and do not fit the old A229 Duo.
findings.source_title: VIOFO Rear Cable/Interior Cable for A229 Plus/A229 Pro/A229 Ultra Car Dash Camera
findings.note: Maker text: 'This cable cannot be extended manually by connecting other USB cables' and 'unsuitable for the old A229 Duo model.'

findings.label: Hardwire kit for parking mode
findings.value: The HK4 Type-C hardwire kit (4 m, $17.99, was $25.99) lists the A229 Ultra by name. VIOFO's own HK6 documents tie Hybrid Parking and Low Power Impact Detection to the A329S series only.
findings.source_title: VIOFO Type-C HK4 Hardwire Cable For A119MINI2/A229 Plus/A229 Pro/A229 Ultra/A329/T130/WM1
findings.note: The HK6 product title says 'for A329S/A229/A119M Pro Series' ($25.99). Its body says 'Hybrid Parking Mode — Only with HK6' for the A329S, A329T and A329WW. VIOFO's HK6 blog (https://www.viofo.com/blogs/viofo-car-dash-camera-guide-faq-and-news/upgrade-to-hk6-hardwire-cable-smarter-parking-protection-total-peace-of-mind-1, Oct 30 2025, read 2026-11-21) names only the A329S series for Low Power Impact Detection. Productbible's line 'HK6 hybrid parking supported' for the A229 Ultra is not backed by any VIOFO document I opened.

findings.label: Price, sensors
findings.value: $239.99 (list $399.99), sale price with no code. Vantrue's listing says dual Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 sensors with 155° HDR lenses.
findings.note: Read from Vantrue's US Shopify store through storecheck search (the product endpoint returned HTTP 429). It matches the partner list: pay $239.99, variant 51200752189749. There is no Dealectric record yet; one is needed if it goes in the table.

findings.label: Per-channel recording, card ceiling, power
findings.value: 2-channel (front plus rear), both 4K at 30 fps on Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 (front 32 Mbps, rear 24 Mbps). microSD up to 1 TB. Capacitor power. GPS. Parking modes need an optional hardwire kit. A waterproof rear camera is offered.
findings.note: DashCamTalk spec page, published Jan 12, 2026, which links member reviews by Julian23, EricSan, HackMan, Karagandinez and TonyM. Vantrue's manual page separately states 'microSD card (32GB – 1TB)'.

findings.label: Cables, cards and firmware (maker)
findings.value: Use only the original rear cable, because cables from other dash cams are not interchangeable. Cards 32GB to 1TB. Vantrue advises against Samsung EVO Plus and PRO Plus cards. Firmware file is VT_S1PM.bin.
findings.source_title: S1 Pro Max manual and firmware (Vantrue)
findings.note: Maker text: 'Make sure you use the orignal rear cable' and 'Samsung EVO Plus and PRO Plus cards are NOT recommended for use with Vantrue dash cam.'

findings.label: Longer rear cable
findings.value: A 29.5 ft (9 m) Type-C rear cable is listed for the N4 Pro, S1 Pro, E3, N4S, S1 Pro Max and N4PS. $15.99
findings.source_title: 29.5ft Rear Camera Cable for N4 Pro | S1 Pro | E3 | N4 S | S1 Pro MAX | N4PS
findings.note: S1 Pro Max is in the product title. The body text names only the N4 Pro, S1 Pro and E3.

findings.label: Hardwire kit and LTE add-on
findings.value: Vantrue sells the S1 Pro Max 4K + 2.5K in a bundle with its VP03 hardwire kit. The $149.99 4G LTE module lists the S1 Pro Max as compatible.
findings.note: The VP03 pairing comes from the bundle at https://www.vantrue.com/products/bundle-s1-pro-max-4k-2-5k-vp03-256gb-card ($355.97, read 2026-11-21), which is the 4K + 2.5K sibling, not the 4K + 4K version. Vantrue's 'Universal 11.5ft ACC Hardwire Kit' ($24.99) says it works only with Vantrue dash cams.
